issue_request: FHIR-47604 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for R6. The decision removed the DeviceAssociation operator/operation backbone, added DeviceAssociation.focus with the same reference targets as subject, added focus search/compartment participation, and carried operation-status concepts through associationStatus/base period instead of a separate operation backbone.
initial_application: HL7/fhir#3872 removed the operator search parameter, added focus, updated compartments, and began converting examples. HL7/fhir#3897 removed the remaining DeviceAssociation.operation backbone from the StructureDefinition and deleted operation-status terminology. The current source still had operation blocks in active examples and a DeviceAssociation.subject comment describing the removed operation/operator backbone.
additional_context: DeviceAssociation is active in source/fhir.ini and the edited files are current source/deviceassociation inputs. The r5-r6 change list correctly records DeviceAssociation.operation.* removals and DeviceAssociation.focus addition, so it was left unchanged. OO/HCP Confluence minutes corroborate the 2025-10-20 8-0-0 vote. FHIR-53680 later notes the .subject comment confusion but is Waiting for Input and was not decided. Zulip searches found no directly relevant conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Changed source/deviceassociation/structuredefinition-DeviceAssociation.xml so DeviceAssociation.subject no longer describes the deleted operation backbone and instead explains operator relationships with focus. Removed obsolete <operation> blocks from the active DeviceAssociation examples. In operator examples, added relationship=operator and moved the prior operation-status meaning to base associationStatus=on while retaining base period/focus usage.
